timezone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Athens. The calendar is shown in this time zone.

start_date.description: The first day the calendar shows, as YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: How many days the calendar shows, from 1 to 14.

id.description: An ID unique across every item, option and blocked event: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, _ or -.

title.description: What the event is, as the calendar shows it.

start.description: A date and time with an explicit UTC offset, such as 2026-10-02T09:00:00+03:00.

end.description: A date and time with an explicit UTC offset, such as 2026-10-02T09:00:00+03:00. It must be after the start.

blocked.description: Events that are already booked, shown as busy time. Send an empty list when nothing is booked.

id.description: An ID unique across every item, option and blocked event: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, _ or -.

subtitle.description: A second line shown under the title, such as a place or a person.

icon.description: The activity's icon, one of those the plugin carries; calendar when none is given.

id.description: An ID unique across every item, option and blocked event: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, _ or -.

start.description: A date and time with an explicit UTC offset, such as 2026-10-02T09:00:00+03:00.

end.description: A date and time with an explicit UTC offset, such as 2026-10-02T09:00:00+03:00. It must be after the start.

options.description: The suggested times for this activity. Each one must fall within the days the calendar shows.

items.description: The activities to schedule. For each one, the person picks one of the suggested times or leaves it for the agent.
